background: Nykredit is Denmark's largest mortgage lender, a mutual-owned group that funds Danish residential and commercial mortgages through covered bonds under the Danish balance-principle system, with a commercial and retail bank alongside.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, after a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 17.0% is above the peer median, while leverage of 4.5% is in the bottom quarter, as is usual for a mortgage bank funded by covered bonds. Liquidity is very strong, with LCR of 501% and NSFR of 143% both in the top quarter, and NSFR up 10 points since 30 Jun 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days; the mortgage model makes its leverage look thin and its liquidity look enormous.
